author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಓತು ಸಾಸಿರವಿರಲು ಮಾತದಕೆ ಆಧಾರ
ಸೋತಿರುವ ಮನಕೆಂದು ನುಡಿಯೆ ಜೀವಾಳ
ಸೇತುವದೆ ಮಾನವನ ಏಳುಬೀಳಿನ ಜಗದಿ
ಮಾತು ಗುಣಗಳ ಮೊಗೆಯೆ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: There may be a thousand votes, but speech is their foundation;
to a defeated mind, a word is its lifeblood;
it is the bridge in this world of human rises and falls;
draw up good qualities through speech, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Words carry enormous weight. A kind word revives a defeated heart and bridges the ups and downs of life. Let your speech bring out goodness.
